title: How to Use Muse Code: Install, Auth, First Task (2026)

facts.fact: Meta's Muse Code is a CLI coding agent, and the page gives its release date as 2026-08-05.
facts.quote: Muse Code is Meta's CLI coding agent released 2026-08-05.

facts.fact: Meta's primary install path for Muse Code is a single curl command piped to bash from dev.meta.ai.
facts.quote: Install with a single line: curl -fsSL https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh | bash.

facts.fact: After installing, the muse binary is verified by running muse --version.
The first run of muse triggers a browser authentication flow against a Meta developer account.
facts.quote: First run of muse triggers a browser auth flow against your Meta developer account.

facts.fact: As of the page, a documented headless authentication flow for CI or headless environments is not available at launch.
facts.quote: For CI or headless environments, a documented headless auth flow is not available at launch.

facts.fact: Muse Code credentials are cached locally after the first browser authentication, so later runs skip the browser step.
facts.quote: Once authenticated, credentials cache locally. Subsequent runs skip the browser step.

facts.fact: Muse Code records a full event log for every session, covering file edits, tool calls, and decisions.
facts.quote: Every session records a full event log — file edits, tool calls, and decisions.

facts.fact: The muse replay command walks through a recorded session's event log step by step.
facts.quote: Run muse replay to walk it step by step.

facts.fact: Full session traces from Muse Code can be exported for handoff to a teammate or for a compliance review.
facts.quote: Export the full trace when you need to share a session with a teammate or attach it to a compliance review.

facts.fact: The page states that a typical first Muse Code task, from start to a complete worker-reviewer-test round trip, usually takes a couple of minutes.
facts.quote: The whole round trip usually takes a couple of minutes.

facts.fact: The guide was reviewed by Jonathan West and last updated on October 27, 2026.
